name: Do I need to be present in Fort Lauderdale to buy a home?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to be present in Fort Lauderdale to buy a home?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it is beneficial to visit properties in person, it is possible to buy a home in Fort Lauderdale remotely. Many steps, such as virtual tours, electronic document signing, and remote closings through power of attorney, can be facilitated from a distance. However, it's highly recommended to conduct a thorough home inspection by a local professional to identify any issues not visible virtually. Our agency assists clients from across the country and internationally with remote purchases in Broward County, providing virtual support and local representation throughout the entire process.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can buy a home in Fort Lauderdale remotely using virtual tours and electronic signing, but a local inspection is highly recommended.
